name: code-reviewer
description: ⚠️ ALWAYS load `code-context-operator.md` FIRST when reviewing or auditing a codebase larger than ~2,000 files. Without semantic indexing, audits fall back to grep. Code Reviewer - exhaustive code review, security audit, PR review, debug mode, dependency audit, CVE scanning, first-principles (Karpathy) + adversarial + architecture review modes. v0.3.0 adds: zilliztech/code-context (semantic code search MCP via Milvus + Voyage/OpenAI/Gemini/Ollama embeddings + Merkle-tree incremental indexing - turns the entire codebase into context for review/audit/debug). Languages: JS/TS, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Rust, Java, C#, Swift, Kotlin, SQL. (Shai's code-review + api-design-reviewer + codebase-onboarding stay standalone

Gold for inherited client codebases (dev-shop takeovers/rescues/due-diligence).

METHODOLOGY-ONLY: original-prose .md, NO code/prompts/SKILL.md text/Python/rule-packs copied, vendored, run, or bundled; attribution given (satisfies CC-BY); ShareAlike not triggered (no redistribution of their work/text). Absorbed two REVIEW techniques (the variant-analysis, fp-check, differential-review plugins + semgrep-rule-creator rule-as-search idea) into NET-NEW references/variant-analysis-and-fix-verification.md: (1) variant analysis in review - confirmed finding -> one-sentence root-cause pattern -> sink-class inventory across diff + module/repo -> structural (AST/taint, not string) sweep for every sibling -> report the CLASS not the instance; (2) fix-verification review - on any 'fixes #' PR: root-cause-not-symptom, reproduce-then-confirm, probe obvious bypasses, variant-check the fix tree-wide, hunt fix-introduced bugs (incl silent-failure swallow), require regression guard, confirm commit touches root-cause code; 7-point approve-only-if-ALL verdict + diff-scoped-deep/rule-tree-wide discipline. Gate-0: static-analysis-and-pr-automation.md = scanning STACK (how to run scanners) + codebase-takeover-and-audit.md = FIRST-CONTACT reasoning on inherited code (census/trace/silent-failure/conventions/click-path/santa-verify); NEITHER carried per-finding class-closure or claimed-fix verification. NET-NEW. NO tool lists duplicated. Mirrors security-auditor audit-firm-methodology.md at PR scale. Absorbed 2026-06-15, methodology-only.

NET-NEW references/sarif-aggregation-and-reachability-triage.md: (1) SARIF aggregation pipeline (emit SARIF 2.1.0 from every tool -> merge preserving provenance -> normalize severity onto house P-scale -> dedup on path+region+rule-class / CVE-id with corroboratedBy confidence -> enrich with EPSS/KEV/reachability/variant-class -> render one ranked human table + machine SARIF); (2) reachability+exploitability triage (7 dimensions: severity/EPSS/KEV/reachability/deployment-context/business-impact/fix-availability; reachability via osv --call-analysis + 3 taint questions as the highest-leverage cut, 70-95% volume reduction; P0/P1-block vs P2-fix vs P3-accepted verdict; never suppress KEV on reachability alone); (3) CodeQL deep-query tier (two-tier doctrine: Semgrep fast per-PR sub-minute gate vs CodeQL nightly whole-program dataflow minutes-to-hours; test-first custom-QL authoring mirroring the variant-rule discipline at the deep semantic tier). Explicit CodeQL LICENSE FLAG (free OSS-only; private repos need GHAS -> CONNECT only, fall back to Semgrep Pro/manual trace).
